items.text: Page title ('CBD Oil Cream'), H1 ('How To Make Cannabis Oil'), top-bar text ('Where To Buy Cbd Cream For Pain') and brand logo ('ZATURAL') all name different things.
items.evidence: facts.title='CBD Oil Cream'; h1.text='How To Make Cannabis Oil'; slice_00 top bar and logo image cropped-Z-Logo-CBD.png

items.text: Most headings are keyword phrases that don't match the content under them, e.g. 'Cbd Vape' sits above copy about general CBD questions and 'Lazarus Naturals' above copy about pet CBD.
items.evidence: heading_outline h2 'Cbd Vape', 'Lazarus Naturals'; slice_01/02 body text 'Got questions about CBD?' and 'CBD isn't just for people...pets'

items.text: Headings and product names use title case on every word, including the acronym written as 'Cbd' rather than 'CBD'.
items.evidence: heading_outline: 'Cbd For Dogs & Favourites', 'Cbd Oil Amazon', 'Cbd Clinic Products'

items.text: The page uses two type families: Helvetica Neue sans-serif for headings, navigation and buttons, and Georgia serif for body paragraphs.
items.evidence: fonts_by_element_count: Helvetica Neue 182, Georgia 153; serif paragraphs visible in slice_00 hero subtitle and slice_02 article

items.text: The H1 is 54.4px, weight 700, white Helvetica Neue, and the H2s are 35.2px bold.
items.evidence: facts.h1 font_size 54.4px, weight 700, color rgb(255,255,255); h2 font_size 35.2px

items.text: Body text is 16px on a 26.4px line height (1.65 ratio).
The palette centres on dark forest greens, with a muted gold accent and a warm off-white background.
items.evidence: body_bg rgb(250,248,243); backgrounds rgb(31,65,48), rgb(47,93,70), rgb(201,162,75); body_color rgb(38,48,42)

items.text: A thin dark green utility bar runs across the top, with a tagline on the left and 'Contact Us · 208-969-1282' on the right.
The white header bar holding the logo, a centred five-item nav and a 'Cart (0)' pill overlaps the hero image, leaving an empty off-white band above it.
items.evidence: slice_00: blank band at about y=32–103; hero image visible behind and above the nav at y≈103–132

items.text: The hero background photo contains its own baked-in text ('ZATURAL CBD.', 'SHOP HERE', a GMP seal), which shows through the darkened overlay behind the H1.
The hero text block is left-aligned: H1, then a serif subtitle, then the gold CTA.
Content sits in a centred container about 1088px wide (x 176–1264) on a 1440px page.
items.evidence: image rects start at x=176 and end at x=1264; layout.page_width 1440

items.text: The category graphics show ghosted duplicate title text behind the main title, e.g. a darker 'CBD OILS' behind 'CBD OILS'.
The product row is a four-column grid of white cards with rounded corners and thin borders. Each card holds a 252px image, a bold green product name and a price line.
Price lines use the 'From: $X' format for variable products.
Sections alternate between off-white and white backgrounds, separated by thin horizontal rules.
items.evidence: slice_01 rule at about y=333; slice_02 rule at y≈833; slice_03 at y≈223

items.text: The news section is a narrow, left-aligned article column (about 760px wide) with a small uppercase gold eyebrow label 'IN THE NEWS' above the H2.
items.evidence: slice_02 article at x≈340–1100; tag_counts article:1

items.text: The article body is long-form serif prose with wording that reads like it was machine-paraphrased ('one of those traits', 'remedy', 'merchandise').
A pull quote is set as an italic serif blockquote with a gold left border.
items.evidence: tag_counts blockquote:1; slice_03 gold vertical rule

items.text: 'Shop by Category' is a three-column grid of 349px square tiles. Each tile is a product graphic with a solid colour field (green, brown, navy) and a 'SHOP NOW' label baked into the image.
The newsletter band is a full-width medium-green block with centred white heading and serif subtext, a white pill email input and a gold pill 'Sign Up' button.
items.evidence: bg rgb(47,93,70); tag_counts form:1, input:1, button:1; slice_03

items.text: The page has 128 anchors and 98 list items but only 445 words, which suggests large link lists, probably inside the collapsed disclosure.
The footer bottom row has a '© CBD Oil 2020' copyright and a payment-icons image on a white rounded panel, separated from the columns by a thin rule.
Border radii fall into two groups: square (222 elements) and 16px or more (99), with almost none in between.
The heading outline is one H1, eight H2s and seven H3s, with H3s used for both product cards and footer column titles.
All 15 images have alt text.
Styling comes from one inline style block with no external stylesheets and a small set of semantic class names; none of the classes look like Tailwind utilities.
items.evidence: style:1, stylesheets 0, classes unique 27 of 54 total, tailwind_like_fraction 0

items.text: There is no structured data, and the head has only three meta tags (charset, viewport, description).
The middle of the page has three alternating image/text split rows: image left, then image right, then image left, each with a 520px square image.
items.evidence: CBD-Statue x=176, AliNOMNOM x=744, CBD-dog-oilPET x=176, all 520x520

items.text: The copy contains no emoji or em dashes and only 2 exclamation marks (the 'Sale!' badges).
The page is about 5604px tall at a 1440px width.
Layout uses 7 grid containers and 11 flex containers.

Product card names don't match their images or prices: 'Cbd Oil Amazon' is a subscription box at $79.00 and 'Cbd For Life' is a yellow dropper bottle. The h3 text looks like keyword-style labels (Cbd For Life, Pure Cbd, Cbd).
items.evidence: h3 list: Cbd For Life, Pure Cbd, Cbd Oil Amazon, Cbd; alts 'CBD infused lemon', 'CBD honey, 450mg'

items.text: The feature photos are lifestyle shots: a bronze statue holding a CBD bottle, a woman using a dropper outdoors, and a dog with a dropper over a canyon. They contrast with the studio product renders elsewhere.
items.evidence: alts 'CBD statue', "Charlotte's Web CBD oil", 'CBD oil for pets'

items.text: The article repeats a UK FSA / regulator story and quotes the FSA's chief executive, via The Guardian, with a '31 March 2021' deadline. The copy is long-form news-style prose inside a shop landing page.
items.evidence: slice 2–3 paragraphs: 'FSA Chief Executive Emily Miles...', quote ending 'earlier than 31 March 2021'

features.statement: Headings are keyword-style phrases that don't match the content or imagery beneath them, with mismatched titles, products and labels.
Headings and product names are title-cased on every word, including acronyms rendered in mixed case.
Sans-serif (Helvetica Neue) is used for headings, nav and buttons, while serif (Georgia) is used for body paragraphs.
Large bold white H1 (about 54px) and bold H2s (about 35px) form a clear heading scale.
Body text is 16px with a generous line height of about 1.65.
Palette is dark forest greens with a muted gold accent on a warm off-white background.
A thin dark utility bar at the top holds a tagline on the left and contact details on the right.
A white header bar with logo, centred nav and a cart pill overlaps the hero image, leaving an awkward empty band above.
Hero background photo contains baked-in text and seals that show through a dark overlay behind the headline.
Hero content is left-aligned: a headline, then a serif subtitle, then a gold call-to-action button.
Content sits in a centred fixed-width container of about 1088px on a wider page.
Category graphics carry ghosted duplicate title text and baked-in labels like 'SHOP NOW' on solid colour fields.
Products appear as a four-column grid of white cards with rounded corners, thin borders, square images, bold names and price lines.
Sections alternate off-white and white backgrounds, separated by thin horizontal rules.
A narrow left-aligned article column uses a small uppercase gold eyebrow label above the heading.
Long-form serif prose reads as machine-paraphrased, news-style text embedded in a commercial landing page.
Pull quotes are italic serif blockquotes with a gold left border.
A full-width medium-green newsletter band has centred white heading, a white pill email input and a gold pill button.
Footer bottom row has a copyright and payment-icons image on a white rounded panel, separated by a thin rule.
Border radii are bimodal: either square corners or large radii of 16px and above, with few in between.
Heading hierarchy has one H1 with several H2s and H3s, with H3s reused for both card titles and footer column titles.
All images carry alt text.
Styling is one inline style block with a small set of semantic class names and no utility-class framework.
Head is minimal, with no structured data and only charset, viewport and description meta tags.
Mid-page uses alternating image/text split rows with large square images switching sides.
Copy avoids emoji and em dashes and uses almost no exclamation marks.
Feature photography is lifestyle imagery, contrasting with studio product renders used elsewhere.
Page has many links and list items but little text, suggesting large link lists in collapsed footer disclosures.
